learning.association: 独立指改动边界，不把人物独处或单个控件位置当证据。
learning.collocation: an isolated change; keep a change isolated
learning.example:
A: Add one switch for dark mode. Keep this change isolated.
B: I'll update only the setting and its behavior.
A: Verify it before starting the next incremental change.
B: I'll check both positions of the switch and report the result.
